class NeedsNew { constructor(public n: number) {} }
const constructed = NeedsNew(1);
function fixedThenRest(first: number, ...rest: number[]) { return first; }
const unknownLength: number[] = [];
fixedThenRest(...unknownLength);
class FixedRest { constructor(public first: number, ...rest: number[]) {} }
new FixedRest(...unknownLength);
